title: clock.jobs_due
description: Clock jobs that enqueue work during [from, to) (BE-CK-2..4, BE-CK-10, BE-CK-12), with the number of runs. A clock process started at `from` evaluates its schedule at `from` and at every whole second after it (ticks). An interval job runs at the first tick and then at the first tick at least one period after its previous run (a period below one second: every tick). A minute-pinned job runs at a tick whose UTC minute (and hour, for a daily job) equals its pin and that is at least one period (1 h, or 1 day) after its previous run: started at 00:05:30, the :05 jobs run at 00:05:30 and 01:05:30. A run counts only when the job's gate lets it enqueue work. `env` lists the deployment settings that change the schedule (absent key = unset = empty text), read as BE-CK-12 states. Profile corrected (RBD-79, proposed): refresh_wallets_ongoing_balance is scheduled whatever the cache settings, unless LAGO_DISABLE_WALLET_REFRESH is exactly `true`.

LAGO_SUBSCRIPTION_ACTIVITY_PROCESSING_IN.description: Period in seconds (default 60 when blank): leading integer after leading whitespace, optional sign, a single underscore between two digits skipped (1_20 -> 120, 3__0 -> 3).

LAGO_LIFETIME_USAGE_REFRESH_INTERVAL_SEC.description: Period in seconds (default 300 when blank), read like the activity period.

LAGO_DISABLE_LIFETIME_USAGE_REFRESH.description: On only for the exact text `true` (the job still ticks, enqueues nothing).

LAGO_MEMCACHE_SERVERS.description: Cache configured when not blank (any text).

LAGO_REDIS_CACHE_URL.description: Cache configured when not blank (any text).

LAGO_DISABLE_WALLET_REFRESH.description: On only for the exact text `true` (the job is not scheduled).

LAGO_WALLET_ONGOING_BALANCE_REFRESH_INTE.description: Period in seconds (default 300 when blank), read like the activity period.

LAGO_DISABLE_EVENTS_VALIDATION.description: On for any non-empty text except 0, f, F, false, FALSE, off, OFF (the job is not scheduled).

LAGO_REDIS_STORE_URL.description: Set when not blank (any text); with LAGO_CLICKHOUSE_ENABLED set, schedules refresh_flagged_subscriptions.

LAGO_CLICKHOUSE_ENABLED.description: Set when not blank, whatever the text (`false` counts as set).

runs.description: Job name -> number of runs; jobs with no run are absent (an expected null asserts that the job does not run).
